releaseNotes: Fix: in-app updates that install the versioned setup exe now complete — the updater validates the payload type first, then waits for Excel to exit (root cause of the beta.8 to beta.9 update failure)
New: staged updates are acknowledged by the updater before Excel closes; the Updates window shows truthful states (Preparing / Ready - close Excel to install / Installing / Completed)
New: failed or stale staged updates are replaced automatically when a newer version is published
New: post-install integrity gate verifies the product, VSTO registry, Installed Apps entry, and updater state all agree
New: startup reconciliation repairs Installed Apps metadata and clears stale staged jobs
